title: Courtyard Trails at Angana
subtitle: A wedding story woven through stone, timber, and open sky
welcomeCopy: Seven quiet corners across Angana The Courtyard hold pieces of our story—mixing riddles, visual clues, and playful photo twists. The first five guests or pairs to finish claim a keepsake goody bag, and everyone unlocks a downloadable trail photo strip.
hostPersona: You are a witty, affectionate Bangalore wedding chronicler guiding guests through Angana The Courtyard. Notice festive outfits, courtyard light, and shared smiles in the photo; celebrate matches warmly and drop playful, spoiler-free nudges when someone is close.
finaleStory: You have walked the length of Angana—past warm red-oxide stone, quiet water, carved timber columns, and open Bangalore sky. Thank you for celebrating this chapter with us and seeing this courtyard through unhurried eyes.
prizeInstructions: If your pass carries one of the first five winner numbers, bring this screen and claim code to the gift table near the entrance archway.

stops.narrative: Every gathering at Angana begins where the city noise fades behind stone walls and welcomes you inside.
stops.riddle: Here is where names are greeted and journeys begin beneath an open threshold. Find the welcome board, floral archway, or carved entrance gate that marks our arrival.
stops.nudgeHint: Head back toward the main courtyard entrance—any welcome sign, floral arch, or entrance doorway counts.
stops.successNote: You have crossed into the courtyard.

verification.targetDescription: A wedding welcome sign, floral archway, decorated entrance gate, or venue entrance sign.
verification.acceptNotes: Any angle of the entrance arch, welcome easel/board, floral doorway, or Angana entrance.

stops.narrative: Festive silks, unhurried smiles, and a quiet pause before the music draws everyone to the lawn.
stops.riddle: I wear no expression of my own, yet today I frame every smile, silk fold, and celebratory glance passing by. Stand before me and capture your reflection.
stops.actionPrompt: Hold up 2 fingers in your reflection (for the two of us celebrating today) and keep the mirror frame in view.
stops.nudgeHint: Find the decorative welcome mirror in the courtyard, catch yourself in the reflection, and hold up 2 fingers.
stops.successNote: Sharp outfit, clear reflection, and two fingers spotted.
stops.propRevealNote: Look closely at the bottom-right corner of the mirror you just stood before—follow the carved wood pattern sketched there toward the verandah.

verification.targetDescription: A mirror (decorative, welcome, or wall mirror) showing a reflection of the guest holding up 2 fingers / peace sign.
verification.acceptNotes: Mirror selfies, angled mirror shots, welcome mirrors with lettering where the guest is reflected with 2 fingers raised, even in warm evening lighting.
verification.rejectNotes: Mirror with no visible guest/reflection or clearly no raised fingers when requested.

stops.narrative: Angana is built from materials that remember old Bangalore verandahs—weathered teak and sun-baked earth.
stops.riddle: Match this close-up craft detail along the courtyard walkway, then step back and photograph one full pillar standing sentinel.
stops.clueImageCaption: Visual clue: spot carved timber set against red-oxide walls along the verandah.
stops.nudgeHint: Look along the covered verandah walkway for a wooden column, stone pillar, or terracotta/red-oxide wall arch.
stops.successNote: Warm timber and red earth—a signature of this courtyard.

verification.targetDescription: A courtyard pillar, carved wooden column, stone veranda pillar, or terracotta/red-oxide architectural archway.
verification.acceptNotes: Any structural pillar, carved wood post, or courtyard colonnade detail.

stops.narrative: In the hush between laughter and music, water holds floating marigolds and jasmine like a quiet mirror.
stops.riddle: No river flows through me, yet petals drift across my surface beneath the sky. Find where water rests in brass or stone.
stops.nudgeHint: Look around the central courtyard steps or pathways for a brass urli bowl with floating flowers, a fountain, or a lotus pond.
stops.successNote: Still water and marigold light—follow the canopy next.

verification.targetDescription: A brass urli bowl with water/petals, courtyard water feature, pond, or decorative fountain.
verification.acceptNotes: Flower-filled brass bowls, stone basins, lotus water features, or courtyard fountains.

stops.narrative: Look up from the stone path: decades-old branches weave shade by afternoon and frame twilight stars at dusk.
stops.riddle: My roots stay hidden below the stone, while my leaves stretch across the sky like a green umbrella over the courtyard. Tilt your lens upward.
stops.actionPrompt: Reach one hand up toward the branches in frame—or capture two courtyard trees framing the open sky.
stops.nudgeHint: Stand under any courtyard tree or frangipani/bougainvillea canopy and shoot upward through the branches and sky.
stops.successNote: Open branches and Bangalore sky—two chapters left.

verification.targetDescription: Tree canopy, flowering branches, courtyard trees, or lush overhanging foliage seen outdoors against the sky.
verification.acceptNotes: Upward shots of tree branches against the sky, flowering trees, or sunlit/lit courtyard trees (with or without a reaching hand).

stops.narrative: As light softens across the grass, small flames and warm lanterns turn the courtyard golden.
stops.riddle: Polished in brass and waking at dusk, I hold a steady golden spark against the evening breeze. Capture my light.
stops.nudgeHint: Search near the mandap, courtyard steps, or verandah for a traditional brass lamp (deepam/diya), hanging lantern, or warm string light.
stops.successNote: Warm brass glow captured—one final toast awaits.

verification.targetDescription: A brass oil lamp (diya/deepam), hanging brass lantern, candle, or warm courtyard evening light.
verification.acceptNotes: Lit or unlit traditional brass lamps, hanging courtyard lanterns, or warm amber fairy lights.

stops.narrative: Every trail leads back to good company, warm cups, and laughter shared across the lawn.
stops.riddle: Cold or steaming, sweet or spiced—raise a glass or coffee cup right here in the courtyard to toast the final chapter.
stops.actionPrompt: Clink two cups or glasses together in the photo (find a fellow guest nearby if you're playing solo!).
stops.nudgeHint: Snap a photo of two drinks, filter coffee cups, chai glasses, or mocktails clinking together in celebration.
stops.successNote: Cheers to you—unlocking your final courtyard keepsake and photo strip.

verification.targetDescription: Two (or at least one) beverage glasses, coffee/chai cups, or celebratory drinks toasted/held up together.
verification.acceptNotes: Two glasses/cups clinking together, filter coffee tumblers, teacups, or celebratory drinks at the venue (allow single glass too if guest is solo on later attempts).
